name: dsh-esc-rewind
description: Keyboard + command rewind for the DSH Web conversation. ESC once stops the running turn; ESC again rewinds the whole just-stopped exchange (fork a branch from the previous completed turn, restore the prompt into the composer); the `/rewind` slash command restarts from any historical exchange. Client-driven via the official sessions (fork/create/binding) and uiWorkspace (openSession — the 0.2.0 home of the switch-session verb), workspaces (archive), conversation (cancel/updateQueue/draft images), uiConversation (node snapshots) and commandUi (popupSelect contribution) services. Optional DELETE mode: a session-header toggle (archive ⇄ permanently delete the old session after a rewind) persisted through the `esc-rewind` settings namespace, with a small self-hosted half (src/index.js) serving the delete endpoint/tool — no dependency on any third-party delete implementation.
